# Doña Alicia Tampa

> Cuban Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Ropa vieja, yuca bites and snapper over lemon-cilantro risotto, on Linebaugh Avenue.

- Phone: (813) 336-4850
- Address: 9664 W Linebaugh Ave, Tampa, FL 33626
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Dine at the table; Cafe and sweets; Order online
